title: Embedded help links with section fragments were rejected
description:
The initial embedded catalog published URI links with section fragments while lookup accepted only the complete base URI. Following a published recipe link returned unknown topic/resource. Fixed before delivery by removing the fragment before exact compiled-whitelist lookup, with full-document/canonical-base response; regression passed in final34-case native and sanitizer suites; independently reinspected.

Imported from .factory/findings/archive/FND-20261104203810-488c-mcp-agent-guides-003.json (category: functional, blocking: no).
